cohort: The study included 3102 women screened 6-8 weeks postpartum at Camposampiero Hospital between 2012 and 2017.
finding: The study found that 14.6% of 3102 women screened positive for psychological disorders 6-8 weeks postpartum, with 23.6% of these diagnosed with Adjustment Disorder (AD) and 5.5% with Postnatal Depression (PPD), and identified specific risk factors for each condition.
